2026-10-18 r57/r58 source freeze. Supersedes P8's BF16 MT and fixed Demucs-growth assumption.

P9 native Qwen language: server reads the installed streaming state's language and emits text/language_raw/language_code/language_source/session_id/is_final. Missing/unmapped code stays null. Qwen3ASRService returns the structured result. Qwen3ASR retains the language from the same recognition call. The streaming recognizer snapshots it before commit rebuilds remote state; silence-final and explicit-final retain their own result before reset.
P10 controller: each final segment inherits that native result. MT uses its language code; source_english/language_unknown/language_unsupported deliver terminal no-PCM records before queue completion. English is left for the caller's exact original-audio restoration. A source_language_detected event announces each known-code change. Unknown native labels remain in source/terminal fields. No configured-language override impersonates native evidence. Existing supported-language dictionary remains the conservative service allowlist; unmappable Cantonese/Filipino names are unknown rather than guessed ISO-639-1 aliases. Original tracker, prompt manager, segment splitting, serial MT/TTS controller and processed queue barriers remain.

P11 Q8: exact mradermacher/LMT-60-8B-GGUF Q8_0 identity f7671cd4fca54b20398754d89de00e340cdf422b6ffe6976f63e4ee522150ead. Budget counts only this selected GGUF file, 768 MiB KV and 1536 MiB MT overhead. ASR remains BF16 with 1024 MiB KV/1024 MiB overhead. MT flags are --quantization gguf --load-format gguf --dtype half --tokenizer ORIGINAL_LMT --hf-config-path ORIGINAL_LMT, eager, seq1, maxlen/batchedtokens4096. No fallback model/server or CPU inference.
Installed source read through Ubuntu UNC (no imports): vllm0.14 engine/arg_utils.py local GGUF handling and --hf-config-path; model_executor/model_loader/gguf_loader.py local-file loader and Qwen3 tensor-name mapping; layers/quantization/gguf.py Q8_0 support and Blackwell supported activation dtypes half/float32 (not BF16); gguf0.19.0 ReaderField.contents and QWEN3 constants.
Actual installed /root/kevflix-xt/models/lmt/config.json read: model_type qwen3, Qwen3ForCausalLM, hidden_size4096, intermediate_size12288, layers36, heads32, KVheads8, head_dim128, padded vocab151936. gguf_header.py compares these runtime config values, not copied prose constants. It checks GGUF2/3, Q8_0 weights/F32 vector norms, embedding shape and padded vocabulary; original tokenizer IDs must fit the padded model vocabulary, not equal its token count. Original tokenizer_config chat_template is required and hashed. The helper is CPU-only under the owned supervisor, before any models, with heartbeat/floor checks and a bounded deadline. Header or vLLM MT startup failures are fatal xt_mt_gguf_unsupported with diagnostics.
XTServices.set_demucs_memory accepts only the live resident's fresh successful CUDA window. Budget recomputes max(peak_reserved_bytes-current_reserved_bytes,0); fresh free already includes current residency. No fixed zero growth fallback remains. This measures the preceding window, not a larger future-window peak guarantee. Runtime floor3072 and per-vLLM fresh launch admission remain.
